meta.title: translationCore | Open tools for church-led Bible translation
meta.description: Open tools for churches and translation teams to understand, translate, and check Scripture. translationCore Desktop and Mobile are free and open source.

faq.a1: Yes. translationCore Desktop and translationCore Mobile are free and open source, and the Biblical Resources are open-licensed and free to use, share, and adapt.
faq.a2: Yes. translationCore Desktop and translationCore Mobile both work offline.
faq.q3: Which devices does translationCore run on?
faq.a3: translationCore Desktop runs on Windows, Mac, and Linux. translationCore Mobile runs on Android, iPhone, and the web.
faq.a4: translationCore is an initiative of unfoldingWord. Its tools help churches and translation teams understand, translate, and check Scripture.
